name: Tumbao anticipation bass
desc: Salsa tumbao bass in G minor: hits the 'and of 2' and lands the beat-4 anticipation note tied over the barline (@ elongation on a plain note), voicing the next chord's root early across an i-VI-iv-V progression that alternates each cycle. Sawtooth with a slow filter bloom; peak drops a downbeat sub and gallops with octave pops.

code.sparse: note("<[~ ~ ~ g2 ~ ~ g2@2] [~ ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ c2@2] [~ ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~ eb2@2] [~ ~ ~ d2 ~ ~ d2@2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}).slow(16)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.2).shape(.2).gain(${gain}*.85).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.full: note("<[g2 ~ g2 g2 ~ g3 d2@2] [c2 ~ c2 c2 ~ c3 g1@2] [eb2 ~ eb2 eb2 ~ eb3 bb1@2] [d2 ~ d2 d2 ~ d3 a1@2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(16)).lpq(3).attack(.01).decay(.35).sustain(.3).release(.2).shape(.25).gain(${gain}).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[g1 g2 g2 g2 f2 g3 d2@2] [c2 c2 c3 c2 bb1 c3 g1@2] [eb1 eb2 eb2 eb2 d2 eb3 bb1@2] [d1 d2 d2 d2 c2 d3 a1@2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.8).slow(8)).lpq(3).attack(.008).decay(.3).sustain(.28).release(.2).shape(.3).gain(${gain}).room(.12).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
